anatomy.demo: GET/api/posts?page=2

parts.desc: GET 读取、POST 创建、PATCH 修改、DELETE 删除
parts.desc_en: GET reads, POST creates, PATCH updates, and DELETE removes.

parts.desc: 资源地址，最好使用名词并保持复数规则一致
parts.desc_en: The resource address, usually a consistent noun.

parts.desc: 用于筛选、搜索、排序和分页，不应该包含密码或令牌
parts.desc_en: Used for filtering, search, sort, and pagination—not secrets.

use.t: 用方法 + 名词路径表达意图：GET /users、POST /users
把路径参数、查询参数和请求体分清楚
每条端点写清输入、成功响应、错误状态和权限要求
先用浏览器 Network、curl 或 API 工具单独验证端点

dont.t: 不要把所有功能放进一个含义不清的通用端点
读取数据却用 POST、删除数据却用 GET：会偏离 HTTP 语义，也可能影响缓存和安全预期
只设计成功响应：参数缺失、冲突和服务失败时也应返回约定的状态与错误信息
把密码、令牌等敏感信息放在 URL 查询参数里：它们可能进入浏览历史和访问日志

lessonPractice.title: 同一个“文章”资源既要读取列表，也要创建新文章。怎样安排端点更清楚？

options.label: GET /api/posts 读取，POST /api/posts 创建，并分别约定结果
options.feedback: 方法和路径一起表达要处理的资源与动作，两条端点还能分别说明输入、成功和失败状态。

options.label: 所有功能都发到 /api/do，再让后端从一句文字里猜动作
options.feedback: 通用入口隐藏了资源和操作，文档、权限、错误处理和单独测试都会变得更难。

options.label: 读取和创建都使用 GET /api/posts，只改变请求体内容
options.feedback: GET 通常用于读取，而且请求体没有通用语义；创建应按接口约定使用能表达写入的方法。

en.title: The same Posts resource needs to list existing posts and create a new one. How should the endpoints be arranged?

options.label: Use GET /api/posts to list and POST /api/posts to create, with separate result contracts
options.feedback: Method and path together express the resource and action, while each endpoint can define its own inputs and outcomes.

options.label: Send every operation to /api/do and let the backend infer the action from free text
options.feedback: A generic endpoint hides resources and actions, making documentation, permission checks, errors, and testing harder.

options.label: Use GET /api/posts for both listing and creation and only change the request body
options.feedback: GET normally reads data and has no generally defined request-body semantics. Creation needs a method that expresses a write.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查文章接口：GET /api/posts 负责读取列表，POST /api/posts 负责创建文章。分别写清输入、成功结果、失败状态和权限要求，并用实际请求验证两条端点没有混用。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Review the post endpoints: GET /api/posts lists posts and POST /api/posts creates one. Define inputs, successful results, failure states, and permission requirements for each, then verify both with real requests.

dont.t: Use one endpoint for many unrelated operations
Change data through a read-only method
Hide every failure behind the same generic response
